adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the new `refreshOAuthTokens` wrapper is invoked with the third argument `credentialId` (see the call: `refreshOAuthTokens(..., "zoho-bigin", credentialId)`) whereas the wrapper’s signature treats the third argument as `userId` and sends it as `calcomUserId` to `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` (`refreshOAuthTokens.ts`: `calcomUserId: userId.toString()`). Other integrations consistently pass `credential.userId`. This makes Zoho Bigin send a non-user identifier to the sync endpoint, which can cause refresh/sync to act on the wrong user or fail.
